stops.title: Di Fɛloship dɛn
stops.caption: Ɛvri smɔl grup, ɛn in tayp.
stops.speech: Fɛloship de lis ɛvri smɔl grup: K-Groups, Kharis Express, New Breeds, wit udat de lid ɛn we tɛm dɛn de mit.

stops.title: Filta bay Tayp
stops.caption: Mek am smɔl to wetin yu want.
stops.speech: Di bɔtin dɛn pan tɔp de filta bay tayp, ɛn di drɔpdawn de mek am smɔl to wan branch.

stops.title: Fɛn am pan Map
stops.caption: Di grup we nia di mɛmba.
stops.speech: Di map de put dɛn bay ples, we de ansa di kwɛstyɔn: us wan nia mi.
